ValidationRule.description: Restrict users from being able to opt in users to Email
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( HasOptedOutOfEmail = FALSE, ISCHANGED(HasOptedOutOfEmail), OR( $Profile.Name = "FPC - MCA - Sales User", $Profile.Name = "FPC - WC - Renewal Sales", $Profile.Name = "NF - Hybrid Sales", $Profile.Name = "NF - Working Capital Users" ) ), TRUE, FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You Cannot Opt this Lead into Emails - Please reach out to your manager or Marketing
